lessons_used: Home wait_info changes are consistently helpful, winning 6 out of 11 tests.
Adoption redesigns are generally helpful, winning 3 out of 5 tests.
Choose_path updates (copy, layout, redesign) consistently show no clear positive effect and frequently lead to negative outcomes.
Finish hints, sign-in notifications, and sign-in redesigns consistently show no positive effect, frequently leading to negative impacts or early test stops.
Adoption hints, home redesigns, finish layouts, finish new flows, sign-in copy, and sign-in incentives show no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were systematically too low for large winning changes and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative outcomes; single-test categories remain thin evidence.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Soundscape & Environment Preview Wait Info
candidates.change: Provide an interactive soundscape preview button and environment audio selector while users wait for pet generation.
candidates.why: Lessons show home wait_info changes consistently win (6 out of 11 tests) and home step median time is high at 201s.

waiting.hint: Select and listen to your pet's preferred desktop ambient soundscape while setup completes.

guard.reason: Valid waiting screen info update without breaking rules.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info features consistently win (+1.9% avg), but lacks direct support mail evidence.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Interactive Habitat Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet picker screen into a two-column habitat showcase layout with animated pet previews and rounded selection cards.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns are historically strong performers (3/5 wins) and the adoption step takes a median of 89s.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Preview how your companion moves and lives on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Custom Pet Style & Accessory Customization Flow
candidates.change: Add an accessory and color customization flow step directly within photo upload to set custom pet expectations.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received 3 reports of custom pet generation failing or looking unexpected.

guard.reason: Valid customization flow added inside onboarding step.

candidates.score_note: Backed by support emails, but adding new flow steps requires a release and shows mixed evidence.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Behavior Interactive Preview Info
candidates.change: Display an interactive animation showing how pets move, sleep, and dock on desktops during the waiting process.
candidates.why: Home wait_info tests win consistently, and 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion around desktop pet controls.

waiting.hint: Watch how your pet will interact with your windows and taskbar when desktop setup finishes.

candidates.score_note: Strong match with support emails and proven positive track record for home wait_info changes.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Visibility & Tray Control Guided Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated new screen at the end of onboarding that demonstrates system tray controls and hotkeys for showing or hiding the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on controlling or hiding the pet and 3 emails reported pets not appearing on desktop.

new_desktop_controls_intro.headline: Master Desktop Companion Controls
new_desktop_controls_intro.body: Access your pet anytime from the system tray or use desktop shortcuts to hide and summon.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new onboarding screen after home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Multiple support emails support this, but finish new_screen tests consistently average negative lift (-1.0%).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Personalized Mascot Pledge Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign adoption certificate into a split layout featuring an interactive pet mascot avatar and personalized adoption pledge input.
candidates.why: Adoption step redesigns show positive conversion results (3/5 wins) and increase onboarding commitment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Name your companion and make your adoption pledge to finalize setup.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a mascot cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Companion Care Rules Wait Info
candidates.change: Display interactive companion care and feeding tips alongside progress indicators on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait_info features have high win rate (6/11) and help set user expectations during the 201s median wait.

waiting.hint: Tip: Right-click your pet on desktop anytime to feed or play mini-games.

guard.reason: Valid addition of wait info to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost config update leveraging the reliable home wait_info historical pattern.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Sync & Data Safety Layout
candidates.change: Reframe the sign-in step with a compact layout explicitly explaining cloud pet data preservation and reset protection.
candidates.why: Top support theme was 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet Data
sign_in.body: Your companion progress, items, and custom renders stay safe across devices.

sign_in_options.text: Automatic cloud backup prevents pet data loss.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Readiness Sound Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop chime and system notifications when pet generation completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait time mean is 2336s because users multitask; 3 support emails reported pets not appearing when setup completes in background.

waiting.hint: We will alert you with a gentle sound as soon as your pet lands on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid notification update on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses background drop-off noted in support emails, but notification interventions show limited historical success.

candidates.change: Reorder final onboarding screens by placing a new desktop docking interactive screen before final home intro screen.
candidates.why: Only 36.6% of users finish onboarding overall, and support mails highlight confusion over controlling or hiding desktop pets.

new_desktop_docking_guide.headline: Desktop Docking & Screen Controls
new_desktop_docking_guide.body: Learn how your pet docks to screen borders and sits on top of open applications.

guard.reason: Valid addition and reordering of a new onboarding screen before home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Addresses dropoff at final stage, but finish stage reordering historically carries negative lift.
